name: I Love Taimei - Tampines One
description:
MUST TRY: BBQ Chicken, Popcorn Chicken, Milk Teas, Crispy Squid, Sweet Potato Fries, Tofu Fries, Sunny Island Milk Tea, Mango Popz Fresh Tea. I Love Taimei is a cafe that offers some of the best Taiwanese cuisines in Singapore that are suitable for friends and family get-together. Located at Tampines 1 (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station), I Love Taimei provides a graceful ambiance to make one's dining experience fresh and comfortable. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
